One transient 503 observed in combined sweep for unsupported operation path; retry passed (returned 409).

rca of the issue: Reproduction: run pytest /app/backend/tests/activation_controls/test_activation_validation_positive_unit.py and /app/backend/tests/activation_controls/test_activation_controls_api_live.py. Server logs show traceback at services/activation/validation.py line 20: d['identity']['proposing_principal_id'] KeyError. Root cause: schema/profile accepts owner v1.1 identity with tenant_id, while runtime scope-binding logic still expects proposing_principal_id (legacy field). This mismatch converts valid owner-aligned validations into internal errors (500) before evidence-stage contract outcomes can be returned.
